== Title ==
<span lang="ja">チューイー</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.<ref name="japanese-chewie" />

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。ただし場に敵の単一（＊）キャラクターが3名以上いる場合、配置することができない。</span><ref name="japanese-chewie" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ハン・ソロ船長の忠実なウーキーの相棒。ミレニアム・ファルコンの副操縦士。レイアいわく “歩き回るカーペット”。</span><ref name="japanese-chewie" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Chewie.

'''Lore''' — Captain Han Solo’s loyal Wookiee companion. Co-pilot of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Leia calls him a “walking carpet.”

'''Game text''' — Deploys only on Hoth. After that, he can move anywhere. However, he cannot deploy if three or more of the opponent’s unique (*) characters are on the table.

The Japanese card uses an asterisk for the uniqueness mark in the title and the corresponding reference in the game text. The English face uses a dot.<ref name="japanese-chewie" /><ref>[[:File:ESB2P-L-chewie.gif|Original English card face]], [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game)]].</ref>
